Fix r1: new `zinc` swatch. The first value (#8D9192) rendered near off-white in QA and out-shone the scene, so it shipped as a dull weathered #6E7273; reads as a galvanised pail, not an iron pot. Rim, ears and bail read at 3 m.
Good silhouette and wheel; reads as plantation kit.
Leaned against the shelter in QA; rung spacing reads true to scale.
Simple and correct.

Fix r1: long, low deck (4.4 m at 0.6 m on brick piers) and full-length iron-on-teak rails running 3.6 m past the deck; the roof visibly sits on rollers. Reads as a barcaça, not a pavilion. The raked bean bed reads as a filled bed at gameplay distance, though its ridges are low-contrast against the deck. 2512/3000 tris. The footprint grew to 8.0 m (spec updated).
Fix r1: weathered teak rails on a teak_dark post; no more new-pine read. Tiling and sag kept.
Rework r1: few large, flat, dark dressed basalt slabs (new `basalt` swatch; Príncipe is volcanic) with crisp 4 mm bevels and narrow laterite joints. No pillow or toy read. 572 tris.

Fix r1: ten drooping, double-sided fronds with a notched leaflet edge read as pinnate against the sky; a clear step up from the stiff primitive palms. 588/600 tris, one mesh, three materials. The crown droops uniformly (no upright young fronds); acceptable at 8 m. Next: the A/B G4 swap of the 15 palms.
